'''Formos''', originally known as '''Xoloch''', was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Kessel sector/Legends|Kessel sector]].

==History==
Formos was a [[Planet/Legends|member-world]] of [[Xim's empire|Xim's Empire]] before its collapse in [[25,100 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" /> It became a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] haven that was located near [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]] and its infamous [[Spice/Legends|spice]] mines.<ref name="WOTW" />

Late in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the planet was heavily contested until a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Battle of Formos|victory]] was achieved due to the use of the [[Scorpenek annihilator droid/Legends|Scorpenek annihilator droids]].<ref name="TNEGTD" />
During the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the Imperial officer [[Quirt]] would collect criminals off of the streets of Formos and ship them off to Kessel to work in the mines there.<ref name="WOTW" />

The planet had a [[Formos Spaceport|spaceport]], but outside of the smuggling aspect it had little to offer visitors.<ref name="WOTW" />
